content: Hello everyone! 😊 I'm an independent children's book illustrator. I've completed one children's book, my second is almost finished, and I'm currently working on my third project. I know many first time authors have limited budgets and often struggle to move forward with publishing because illustration costs can be expensive. I truly enjoy helping new authors bring their stories to life, so if your budget is limited I may be able to create a custom offer for you. In some cases I'm also open to discussing a combination of a small upfront payment and a percentage of future book sales depending on the project. If you're a new author looking for an illustrator, feel free to send me a DM or contact me by email. I'd love to hear about your story and see how we can work together. Here is my email: sophiarose083s@gmail.com Thank you for your time and have a wonderful day everyone! 😊

author: Mikaella Ruthzel Briones
title: **WE'RE HIRING | ARCHITECT I**
content: **WE'RE HIRING | ARCHITECT I** **Build the Future with ELEVÉ Architects+** Are you passionate about creating innovative and functional spaces? ELEVÉ Architects+ is looking for a talented and driven **Architect I** to join our growing team! If you're detail-oriented, creative, and ready to contribute to exciting residential, commercial, and institutional projects, we'd love to hear from you. **We're Looking For:** • Bachelor's Degree in Architecture • Licensed Architect is an advantage • 1–3 years of experience in architectural design and construction documentation • **Proficient in Autodesk Revit (Required)** • **Knowledge of Building Information Modeling (BIM) is a must** • Familiar with AutoCAD, SketchUp, Enscape, Lumion/Twinmotion • Knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator is an advantage • Strong attention to detail, communication, and problem-solving skills • Able to work collaboratively and meet project deadlines **Office Location:** **San Pablo City, Laguna** **Work Arrangement:** This is a **project-based position**. While our main office is located in **San Pablo City, Laguna**, successful applicants must be willing to work on assigned project sites depending on project requirements. **How to Apply:** Send your updated **CV and Portfolio** to: **[inquiry@elevearchitects.com](mailto:inquiry@elevearchitects.com)** **Subject Line:** **Application – Architect I – [Your Full Name]** Join **ELEVÉ Architects+** and become part of a team that designs with purpose, delivers excellence, and builds possibilities.
